reviews.t: SHOCKED THAT AMAZON  IS ALLOWING THIS DECEPTION!
reviews.x: I own and purchased a new Salux from Amazon's vendor.  However, Like many others, I received a cheap knock-off brand called "Leyijie" from China, which is inferior to the real Salux towel. I read previous reviews regarding the knock off, but, I thought once Amazon was informed about the deception to their customers, they would rectify the deception.  I was wrong!  I can't tell you how much I love Amazon and I am very surprised that they allow this to continue!!!!

The product was mailed a few days after ordering and arrived just fine.  Basic product, so no complaints there, but when you order a product that is as light as a few pieces of paper, and it costs less than $3 - BUT - you get charged $2.25 for shipping!????  I hate it when sellers deliberately make a profit on shipping "and handling".

claims.text: Many reviewers report receiving a cheap Chinese knockoff (often branded "Leyijie") instead of the authentic Japanese Salux cloth.
Reviewers accuse the seller of false advertising and bait-and-switch, noting the product received does not match the photo shown.
Some customers who received authentic Salux cloths praise them as the real deal and good value.
Positive reviewers highlight that the cloth is long enough to scrub the back and leaves skin smooth and silky.
One reviewer complains about disproportionately high shipping costs for a lightweight, inexpensive item.
